nome_jp: 勝利のレジェンド ガイアール
testo:
Speed Attacker
Triple Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, destroy all creatures that have power 9000 or less.
■ Whenever one of your opponent's creatures is destroyed by this creature, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a non-evolution Dragon, put it into the battle zone. Otherwise. put it on the bottom of your deck.
